title.en: An Act Creating Barrio Mabunaw in the Municipality of Rizal, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte.
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrio Mabunaw in the Municipality of Rizal, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte.

text.en: The sitio of Mabunaw in Barrio Nangca, Municipality of Rizal, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is separated from said barrio, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio in said municipality, to be known as Barrio Mabunaw.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
